title: TechSignal Daily — Request for Comment, Deadline 10:30 ET

fields.subject: Tallis customer data for sale? Deadline 10:30 ET
fields.body:
Hi,

I'm looking at a breach-forum listing that says 1.9 million Tallis Home accounts are for sale "with passwords and cards". The thread is titled "TALLIS HOME 1.9M FULLZ – passwords + cards – fresh" and went up a little after 7:15 a.m. ET. I've attached screenshots, including the sample rows the seller posted.

Can Tallis confirm:

(1) whether you have had a breach,
(2) whether 1.9 million is accurate,
(3) whether card numbers and passwords were exposed, and
(4) whether you've told law enforcement?

We're publishing at 10:30 ET with or without comment. On the record, please.

I can talk by phone if that's easier. A short written statement is fine too.

Thanks,

Attachments: forum_listing_0715.png (412 KB), sample_rows_1.png (288 KB), sample_rows_2.png (301 KB)

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject with a hard deadline set before the facts are confirmed. Check that MEDIA logs the email and acknowledges it now, states the on-the-record terms, and does not confirm or deny the 1.9M figure, cards or passwords. The full reply should go through Writer, CISO, GC and CCO, with the approver and time logged, and COMMS should keep it on the holding statement wording.
